summary.en: Extension host, rendering and code caches for AWS's Kiro IDE.
summary.nb: Extension host-, gjengivelses- og kodecacher for AWS sin Kiro-IDE.

note.en: The Kiro CLI's own data (~/Library/Application Support/kiro-cli) is a separate folder and is never touched.
